description: CRIT-002, CRIT-003, CRIT-004, and CRIT-006's passThresholds all textually require the reviewing adversary to independently EXECUTE code ('re-runs `node --test __tests__/gig.test.mjs`', 're-runs `cd ~/anicca/runtime/loop && node --test ...`', 'runs `cd ~/anicca/skills/economy/gig && node --test __tests__/*.test.mjs`', 'deliberately-induced failure (unreachable/rejecting query function)') and, for CRIT-004, to perform a live/testnet Tier-3 re-attack producing new transaction hashes. This fresh-context contract-review session was granted only Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob tools -- no shell/Bash execution tool and no network tool were available. Every claim in this verdict about test counts, pass/fail status, and behavior was therefore verified by static/control-flow reading of the source files and by grep-counting `test(` occurrences and cross-referencing them against the builder's own RED/GREEN evidence logs (sprint-1-red-phase.log, sprint-1-green-phase.log) -- NOT by this adversary's own execution of `node --test` or any live chain transaction, and NOT by re-scraping business.blockrun.ai or re-running `gh pr view 83`. This is disclosed honestly per this review's own anti-fabrication mandate, rather than fabricating an execution result. It is recorded as a verification_tool_mismatch finding because it means, for THIS specific review pass, CRIT-002/003/004/006/007's own literal passThreshold text ('re-runs itself', 'the adversary's own re-run') could not be fully discharged as written -- a genuine Phase 3 adversary invocation for this sprint MUST be equipped with an actual code-execution tool (and, for CRIT-004's Tier-3 half, live/testnet chain access) or the contract's own binding verification standard is unmet by construction, independent of anything wrong with the contract's text itself (see FIND-001 for a related, contract-side gap in the same area).

recommendation: For the Phase 3 sprint-1 implementation review (as distinct from this contract-negotiation review), ensure the adversary session is provisioned with a shell/Bash execution tool (and testnet/mainnet RPC access for CRIT-004's Tier-3 half) before it attempts to discharge CRIT-002/003/004/006/007 -- a disk-only tool grant is structurally insufficient to satisfy those CRIT items' own literal passThreshold text.
